title: Plantworks job envelope (v1)
description: One job submitted to a team's queue (POST /plantworks/v1/jobs). jobId is the idempotency key. Events go to the team spec's events.callbackDefault, never to a submitter-chosen URL.

jobId.description: kb-<board>-<cardId>-a<attempt>. The board is a Hermes kanban board slug (may contain - and _); the card is a Hermes task id (no -). Only the front door creates a new attempt.

team.description: Team name, equal to the Hermes profile name.

class.description: Queue class from the team spec. Absent means the team's default class.

prompt.description: What the worker is asked to do.

timeoutSeconds.description: Requested job timeout. The broker rejects values above the class ceiling.
